purpose: Evidence notes that support or bound the locked beginner scripts without adding dense research text to the learner-facing pages.
boundary: These references support broad concepts. They do not automatically validate every visual cue, numeric target, cultivar response, or home-grow practice.

sources.title: Controlled environments for cannabis cultivation to support omics research studies and production
sources.limits: Research/production methods source; do not convert its equipment or environmental practices into universal home-grow prescriptions.

sources.title: Is Twelve Hours Really the Optimum Photoperiod for Promoting Flowering in Indoor-Grown Cultivars of Cannabis sativa?
sources.limits: Cultivar responses varied; supports keeping a steady and cultivar-aware flowering light schedule rather than a universal one-size-fits-all number.

sources.title: Scouting a hemp field for disease and insects
sources.limits: Hemp field guidance; supports regular scouting and checking both upper and lower leaf surfaces, not specific indoor treatment recommendations.

sources.title: Postharvest Operations of Cannabis and Their Effect on Cannabinoid Content: A Review
sources.limits: Review emphasizes variable practices and incomplete standards; it should not be used to justify a universal drying or curing endpoint.

sources.title: Postharvest Drying and Curing Affect Cannabinoid Contents and Microbial Levels in Industrial Hemp (Cannabis sativa L.)
sources.limits: Industrial-hemp cultivars and controlled study methods; supports the importance of moisture removal, curing conditions, and microbial risk, not a universal home-grow recipe.

seeds.note: Locked beginner copy is preserved; add a cannabis-specific propagation source before scientific approval.

harvest.note: The page's visual maturity cues need stronger claim-level validation before scientific approval.
